item.title: What is a whois?
item.description: Behind this rather barbaric name hides a very valuable tool for any user who wants to surf “smart”. Whois (contraction of “who is?”, Literally “that is?”) Is a service for consulting the databases “registries” (in French records) to obtain information about a domain name or an IP address. item.title: What is a whois? – Part Two
item.description: Access via recorders (registrars) Some websites provide whois service: this is usually an interface to query one or more bases whois records in order to find out if a domain name is available.
